content:
DO NOT ASK ME TO SEND A SUPABASE ACCESS TOKEN IN CHAT

First, verify the live configuration of the worker service ivx-senior-dev-01.

Return names only, never values:

- AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY: PRESENT / MISSING
- OPENAI_API_KEY: PRESENT / MISSING
- IVX_OWNER_TOKEN_SESSION: PRESENT / MISSING
- Worker HMAC credential: PRESENT / MISSING
- Loaded at startup: YES / NO
- Last restart time
- Last worker heartbeat
- Exact HTTP status of the owner verification endpoint

If AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY is missing:
- Bind the already-approved key from the secure environment group.
- Restart the worker.
- Verify it is loaded.
- Do not ask me to paste the key again unless you prove it is missing or invalid.

For owner authorization:
- Do not require me to paste a Supabase access token into chat.
- Complete the short-lived worker-access-token feature already implemented locally.
- Commit it.
- Push it to main.
- Deploy it.
- Add an authenticated owner action inside the IVX owner dashboard or owner API.
- The owner session must authorize one exact action and commit.
- Generate a 5–15 minute, single-use worker token.
- Store only the hash.
- Consume it once.
- Reject replay.
- Write issuance and consumption to the proof ledger.

Then run one QA-only autonomous job and return:

- GitHub commit SHA
- Render deployment ID
- API live SHA
- Worker live SHA
- Owner authorization ID
- Job ID
- Worker ID
- Token consumed: YES / NO
- Replay rejected: YES / NO
- /health HTTP status
- /version SHA
- Public chat HTTP status
- Final status: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

Do not stop at another checkpoint.
Do not ask me to manually copy browser tokens.
Complete:
CODE → COMMIT → PUSH → DEPLOY → OWNER AUTHORIZE → WORKER EXECUTE → VERIFY → PROOF.
